🎥🎬: Animal Control – Season 5

The chaos at Animal Control is back, and Season 5 picks up with the team facing more bizarre animals, unpredictable situations, and plenty of workplace drama. After everything that went down in Season 4, the crew is ready for another round of cases that push their patience—and teamwork—to the limit.

As the Season 5 preview teases, the animals aren’t the only ones causing trouble. New challenges, unexpected encounters, and the team’s usual dysfunctional chemistry promise even more ridiculous moments as they try to keep their jobs, friendships, and sanity intact.

Catch Animal Control Season 5 at 8:30/7:30c on FOX, and stream it next day on Hulu.
